title: Public versioned/DOI release + methods review
context: M4 is the final milestone and Definition of Shipped: a public, versioned, DOI-able release that someone outside the team actually uses. The release bundle must include all artifacts with provenance and upstream attribution intact: manifests, splits, harness, baselines, datasheets, model cards, the license/provenance ledger, and a citation file. A methods review (domain reviewer + maintainer) must be complete before release. Every artifact must carry the 'not for clinical or diagnostic use' notice. The release gates the adopter/partner task and the sustainability plan. See PLAN.md (M4, Release artifacts).
objective: Prepare and publish a versioned, DOI-able release bundle: package all artifacts (manifests, splits, evaluation harness, baseline code and results, datasheets, model cards, license/provenance ledger, citation file) with upstream attribution preserved (TCGA citation requirement, CC-BY collection attribution). Complete the methods review (domain reviewer + maintainer sign-off). Verify that every artifact carries the 'not for clinical or diagnostic use; research only' notice. Assign a DOI (e.g. via Zenodo or equivalent).
acceptanceCriteria: A versioned release bundle is packaged and published with a DOI: manifests, splits, evaluation harness, baseline code and results, datasheets, model cards, license/provenance ledger, and citation file.
Upstream attribution is preserved in the bundle: TCGA citation requirement noted where applicable; CC-BY collection attribution recorded.
Methods review is complete: domain-reviewer and maintainer sign-off recorded on the task definitions, splits, results, and release artifacts.
Every model card and dataset artifact in the release bundle carries the 'not for clinical or diagnostic use; research only' notice; CI not-for-clinical-use linter passes.
The license/provenance gate is verified at release time: all sources in the release carry approved allow-list entries with retrieval-date and license snapshots.
A citation file (CITATION.cff or equivalent) is included in the bundle.
The release is linked from the project README with DOI.
output: A public versioned/DOI release on Zenodo (or equivalent) containing all benchmark artifacts, with methods review complete, upstream attribution preserved, and every artifact carrying the not-for-clinical-use notice.
